title: 第9章 猛男落泪第10章 真巧
slug: 绑定生子系统后我御兽封神
content_zh:
“爷爷，我不用这些，我东西够。”宋荞赶忙说道。
宋方只能先收了起来：“爷爷的，都是你的。爷爷先替你收着。”
宋荞一时有些无奈。宋方对孙女的溺爱，真的是藏也不藏一下。
“宋方，你是第一次拥有这么丰厚的身家吧？”陈戈忍不住说了一句：“只可惜，身家再丰厚，也换不了有神兽潜质的高等灵兽。”
林颜抱着霸天虎，对着宋荞露出一个笑容来：“师姐，上个月后，御兽场见。”
楚风眠也想要叫嚣什么，但他脸还没有消肿，只能无能狂怒，发出阿巴阿巴的声音。
宋方的脸色微微沉了下来，他冷声说道：“不就是一只霸天虎吗？我能找来第一只，就能找来第二只！”
陈戈笑了：“那我就拭目以待了。”
他转身。
楚风眠和林颜赶忙跟了上去。
宋方心里有些郁闷，看向宋荞时，却又是满面的笑容：“小荞，你放心。爷爷这就出发帮你去找灵兽蛋。爷爷肯定给你找一只更厉害的来。”
“爷爷。”宋荞赶忙拉住了他：“不用。灵兽蛋的事情，我自己有办法。”
嗯？
宋荞能有什么办法？宋方没当真，但他还是下意识说道：“好好好，都听我们小荞的。”
宋荞知道宋方只是敷衍地应着，她也不急。
如果她的想法真的可行，她的第一只灵兽，绝对不会比霸天虎差！
“爷爷，我们先回家。”宋荞说道。
“好好好，先回家。”宋方赶忙应了下来。
路上。
宋荞顺手打开了静音开关。

“宿主，你都做了什么！！”脑海中，顿时响起了系统尖叫声。
宋荞毫不犹豫，再次静音。
等回到了洞府，宋荞再次打开静音。
这次，系统的声音正常多了：“宿主，我的意思是，楚风眠好歹是男主，你不该将他赶走的。男主身上，是最好刷攻略任务的，你和他彻底撕破脸皮，后续的攻略任务，该如何办？”
宋荞饶有兴致地听着，然后问道：“系统，你怎么不尖叫了？”
系统：“……”
为什么不尖叫，这宿主不清楚吗？
身为风靡万界的生子系统，他还是第一次遇到宋荞这种完全不把他放在眼里的。
系统的声音有些干巴巴了起来：“本统完全是为宿主考虑。”
“是吗？”宋荞嘿嘿一笑，继续静音。
系统：“？？？”
content_en:
"Grandpa, I don't need these, I have enough." Song Qiao said quickly.
Song Fang could only put it away first: "Grandpa's is all yours. Grandpa will put it away for you first."
Song Qiao felt helpless for a moment. Song Fang's doting on his granddaughter really didn't hide it at all.
"Song Fang, is this the first time you have such a rich net worth?" Chen Ge couldn't help but say: "It's a pity that no matter how rich the net worth is, it can't be exchanged for a high-level spiritual beast with the potential of a mythical beast."
Lin Yan hugged the Decepticon and smiled at Song Qiao: "Senior sister, I'll see you at the beast control field after one month."
Chu Fengmian also wanted to shout something, but his face was not swollen yet, so he could only cry out in a rage, like "Ababa, Ababa, Ababa."
Song Fang's face darkened slightly, and he said coldly: "Isn't it just a Decepticon? If I can find the first one, I can find the second one!"
Chen Ge smiled: "Then I'll wait and see."
He turned around.
Chu Fengmian and Lin Yan quickly followed.
Song Fang felt a little depressed, but when he looked at Song Qiao, he was smiling again: "Xiao Qiao, don't worry. Grandpa will set out to help you find the spirit beast eggs. Grandpa will definitely find a more powerful one for you."
"Grandpa." Song Qiao quickly stopped him and said, "No need. I have my own ideas about the spirit beast eggs."
Huh?
What can Song Qiao do? Song Fang didn't take it seriously, but he still said subconsciously: "Okay, okay, listen to our little buckwheat."
Song Qiao knew that Song Fang only responded perfunctorily, so she was not in a hurry.
If her idea is really feasible, her first spiritual beast will definitely be no worse than a Decepticon!
"Grandpa, let's go home first." Song Qiao said.
"Okay, okay, go home first." Song Fang responded quickly.
On the road.
Song Qiao turned on the mute switch.
"Host, what have you done!!" A system scream suddenly sounded in my mind.
Song Qiao didn't hesitate and muted his voice again.
After returning to the cave, Song Qiao turned on mute again.
This time, the system's voice was much more normal: "Host, what I mean is that Chu Fengmian is the male protagonist after all, and you shouldn't drive him away. The male protagonist is the best person to complete the strategy missions. If you and he are completely at odds, what should you do with the subsequent strategy missions?"
Song Qiao listened with interest, and then asked: "System, why don't you scream?"
System: "..."
Why doesn't it scream? Doesn't the host know?
As a childbirth system that is popular in the world, this is the first time he has encountered someone like Song Qiao who doesn't take him seriously at all.
The system's voice became a little dry: "This system is completely considering the host."
"Really?" Song Qiao chuckled and continued to mute.
